## Shiny Documents

This quarto document represents the full workflow to add qtofneg flax to Dynlib
sql database, and then to a Combpdb and spectra Objects.
The retention times in Dynlib are in minutes, but in flax data are in seconds.
In the following workflow while adding flax to Dynlib we will unify the units
and convert the retention times of flax data to minutes.

Note: In this file we will need the similarity output file between the
existing database and the new experiment that we would like to to add,
that's why we have to run first this quarto document: \
[QTOF_neg_call.qmd](https://github.com/rebdau/RDynLib_SQL/blob/Ahlam/vignettes/QTOF_neg_call.qmd)
and load the output here.

# Directroy layout

This project follows an  R package layout as follows:

The main project folder is:

RDynLib_SQL/


Within this directory, the structure is organized as follows:

RDynLib_SQL/
├── data/
├── R/
└── vignettes/


### `data/`

Contains the SQLite database files used in the workflow (e.g., `Qtof_flax_neg.sqlite`).

### `R/`

Contains the R source files (`.R`) that define the package functions and core implementation.

### `vignettes/`

Contains Quarto (`.qmd`) files that document the workflow and provide reproducible examples.

In this workflow, the working directory is set to the project root:

RDynLib_SQL/

# Required packages
```{r}
library(Spectra)
library(CompoundDb)
library(DBI)
library(dplyr)
library(RSQLite)
library(here)
register(SerialParam())
library(devtools)

#` Uploading RDynLibSQL: Load all functions of the RDynlib directory
load_all()
```

#Import data from zenodo

Loading the sql database of flax qtof negative from zenodo and create an sql
connection to the database:
```{r}
# flaxseed_QTOFneg
get_dynlib_zenodo(
  doi = ,
  file = "flax_qtof.sqlite",
  destdir = "data"
)
flax_qtofneg <- here("data", "flax_qtofneg.sqlite")
con_fqt <- dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), flax_qtofneg)
```

Loading the sql database of maize qtof negative from zenodo and create an sql
connection to the database:
```{r}
# maize_QTOFneg
get_dynlib_zenodo(
  doi = ,
  file = "maize_qtofneg.sqlite",
  destdir = "data"
)
maize_qtofneg <- here("data", "maize_qtofneg.sqlite")
con_mqt <- dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), maize_qtofneg)
```

Here we show the available tables in both databases:
flax qtof negative:
```{r}
dbListTables(con_fqt)
```

flax qtof negative:
```{r}
dbListTables(con_mqt)
```

Create the output path to store the new database where we will merge the flax
and maize data:
```{r}
# Create new database
dbf <- here("data", "MAIZE_FLAX_QTOFneg.sqlite")
con_merged <- dbConnect(SQLite(), dbf)
```

# Merge flax and maize databases
Here we call the `merge_databases()` function from RDynLib package to merge 
both flax and maize databases:
```{r}
output_db <- here("data", "MAIZE_FLAX_QTOFneg.sqlite")
merge_databases(
  main_db   = maize_qtofneg,
  add_db    = flax_qtofneg,
  output_db = output_db
)

```

#Verify the merged database
Verify the tables in the output database:
```{r}
dbf <- here("data", "MAIZE_FLAX_QTOFneg.sqlite")
con_merged <- dbConnect(SQLite(), dbf)
dbListTables(con_merged)
```

```{r}
dbGetQuery(con_merged, "PRAGMA table_info(msms_spectrum);")
dbGetQuery(con_merged, "PRAGMA table_info(ms_compound);")
```


Ensuring the experiment table has been well merged
```{r}
dbReadTable(con_merged, "experiment")
```

The new experiment has 52 as expid

Ensuring the ms_compound has been well merged
```{r}
dbGetQuery(con_merged, "Select * from ms_compound where expid = 39 LIMIT 10")
```

Add accessions to the database with specefic initials for flax and herbacetin 
experiments, the other experiments would have the first two letters of the user
column from experiment table as initials.
```{r}
add_accessions(dbf, 
                initials_overrides = c("39" = "RD"))
```

```{r}
dbReadTable(con_merged, "experiment")
```


```{r}
dbReadTable(con_merged, "ms_compound")
```


52 is the expid of the new added experiment
```{r}
dbGetQuery(con_mqt, "
  SELECT * FROM ms_compound
  ORDER BY CAST(compound_id AS INTEGER) DESC
  LIMIT 10
")

```

The highest compound_id is 45807 in the Dynlib database

```{r}
dbGetQuery(con_merged, "Select * from ms_compound where expid = 39 LIMIT 10")
```

#Ensuring the msms_spectrum table has been well merged

```{r}
dbGetQuery(con_mqt, "
  SELECT * FROM msms_spectrum
  ORDER BY CAST(spectrum_id AS INTEGER) DESC
  LIMIT 10
")
```
The highest spectrum_id is 45807 in the Dynlib database


```{r}
dbGetQuery(con_merged, "Select * from msms_spectrum where compound_id = 30945 Limit 10")
```

the query results show that the spectrum_id of the added experiment "52" start by 45808 which is correct


#Ensuring the feature_matrix table has been well merged

```{r}
dbReadTable(con_merged, "feature_matrix")
```

```{r}
dbGetQuery(con_merged, "Select * from feature_matrix where expid = 39 LIMIT 10")
```

#Converting the merged sql connection to a compdb object
```{r}
cdb <- CompDb(con_merged)
cdb
```

Show the header of the compoundDb object
```{r}
compounds(cdb) |> head()
```

Convert the compoundDb object to a spectra object
```{r}
sp <- Spectra(cdb)
```

Print the folowing columns from the spectra object:
```{r}
spectraData(sp, columns = c("msLevel", "compound_id", "nodename", "rtime",
                            "retention_time", "spectrum_type"))
```
